2609.12441.title: IMPLY: Physically Anchored Consistency for World-Model Rollouts
2609.12441.paper_summary: A world model asked what happens if an object is pushed at several speeds produces several futures. If the model has the object in mind, those futures agree about it: each implies the same mass and friction. The consistency checks now used to vet world-action models ask whether a model's futures agree with each other, and none of them knows any physics. We show that this is not enough, and what to do instead. IMPLY reads the physics each rollout implies by inverting a simulator and scores a set of rollouts by how well one object explains all of them, anchored to two calibration pushes the model has observed. In a controlled setting, self-consistency gives a perfect score to a model that ignores the object and always predicts a typical push; anchoring exposes it (AUROC 0.70 versus 1.00). On a real model, V-JEPA 2-AC adapted to the scene, the same thing happens. Given its own calibration pushes the model tracks the object (per-object correlation with the truth 0.91); given another object's, it does not (0.05). Self-consistency cannot tell these apart, preferring the right evidence on 52% of objects, chance level, while anchored disagreement prefers it on 73% and correlates 0.92-0.99 with the rollouts' error. Used to choose among candidate rollout sets, it comes within 0.003 of an oracle that sees the truth. A model that has internalised the wrong object is exactly as self-consistent as one that has internalised the right one; consistency has to be anchored to evidence.
2609.12441.paper_summary_zh: 一個世界模型詢問如果一個物體以幾種速度被推動會發生什麼，會產生幾個未來。<lb/>如果模型心中有這個物體，這些未來對它達成一致：每個未來都暗示相同的質量和摩擦力。<lb/>現在用來檢驗世界行動模型的一致性檢查會問模型的未來是否彼此一致，而它們都不知道任何物理學。<lb/>我們顯示這還不夠，並且該怎麼做。<lb/>IMPLY 通過反轉模擬器來讀取每個展開所暗示的物理學，並根據一個物體解釋所有展開的效果進行評分，這些效果以模型觀察到的兩次校準推進為基準。<lb/>在受控環境中，自我一致性給予忽略物體並始終預測典型推進的模型一個完美的分數；而錨定則暴露了它（AUROC 0.70 對比 1.00）。<lb/>在一個真實模型中，V-JEPA 2-AC 適應於場景，發生了相同的情況。<lb/>根據自身的校準推進，模型追蹤物體（每個物體與真相的相關性為 0.91）；根據另一個物體的推進，則不追蹤（0.05）。<lb/>自我一致性無法區分這些，偏好52%的物體上的正確證據，這是隨機水平，而錨定不一致則在73%上偏好它，並且與展開的錯誤相關性為0.92-0.99。<lb/>用來在候選展開集之間進行選擇時，它與一個能看到真相的神諭相差0.003。<lb/>一個內化錯誤物體的模型與內化正確物體的模型一樣自我一致；一致性必須依賴於證據。
